description: 当 Colab / ComfyUI 流程脚本、配置、Notebook 或工作流模板变更时，自动同步更新项目级 colab-comfyui-control Skill

hooks.command: python3 -I -X utf8 -c "import runpy; from pathlib import Path; cwd=Path.cwd(); path=next(d/'.agents/hooks/sync_colab_comfyui_skill.py' for d in (cwd,*cwd.parents) if (d/'.agents/hooks/sync_colab_comfyui_skill.py').is_file()); runpy.run_path(str(path),run_name='__main__')" --hook
hooks.commandWindows: python -I -X utf8 -c "import runpy; from pathlib import Path; cwd=Path.cwd(); path=next(d/'.agents/hooks/sync_colab_comfyui_skill.py' for d in (cwd,*cwd.parents) if (d/'.agents/hooks/sync_colab_comfyui_skill.py').is_file()); runpy.run_path(str(path),run_name='__main__')" --hook
hooks.statusMessage: 同步 Colab 与 ComfyUI 控制 Skill 基线
